inferred_contracts.meaning: Five mode routes are distinct at dispatch; two and four share the same lower implementation by a forwarding wrapper.
Whether replacement contains search text under the helper folding selects first/all flag candidates; original runtime not observed.
Lookup has ASCII folding while the selected sort mismatch path is ordinal; neither Python casefold nor insertion order is assumed equivalent.
TRegEx/TMatch/TGroup declarations refer to TSkRegExp; identity names do not authenticate source revision, license or behavior.
